title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-08-02 21:34:32 最新章节：第1011章 回到祁州
slug: 我在玄幻世界召唤奇物
content_zh:
“痛痛痛，这是哪里？”
随着一道声音在森林里响起，树木上的鸟儿瞬间被惊的四散而逃
齐源一睁眼就感受到了脑袋有种剧烈的疼痛，感觉脑子像是被锤子砸了一下一样。
齐源勉强起身看了看周遭陌生的环境，高大的树木高耸而立，身旁的树木至少两人合抱那么粗，树林中时不时还有不知名的动物叫声。
“我不是在公司加班设计游戏吗？怎么一下子就到这里来了？”齐源强忍疼痛疑惑的看着身边的环境，仔细回想醒来之前发生的事情。
齐源作为一家游戏公司的成员，负责的游戏里面奇物的部分已经设计到尾声了，老板要求加班加点早点设计出来。
作为打工人的齐源也没辙，只能老老实实加班，连续好几天的加班加点，终于在某一天的凌晨三点做完最后一部分的奇物。
然后电脑屏幕就突然发出一道强光，跟当面挨了一发闪光弹似的。
齐源就感觉脑袋一痛，人就晕过去了，等醒来就在这个陌生的树林里。
想到这，作为拥有多年看小说经验的齐源，看着身边陌生的环境心里想道“不会是穿越了吧，我这也没被货车撞呀，难道就因为挨了电脑一发闪光弹？”
随着齐源回想起醒来之前的事情，脑子里的疼痛也渐渐消散，随之而来的是逐渐浮现于眼前简陋的面板。
【创造者：齐源】
【拥有奇物：无】
【抽取次数：1】
看着眼前的面板齐源一愣，“创造者？奇物？是我设计的那个游戏里面的奇物？”
齐源公司做的游戏属于单机游戏，游戏背景是武侠世界。
但是因为奇物的存在，导致武侠世界的战力一直在攀升。
按照游戏里面奇物的设定，万物生灵，一但对某一物品或者事情产生执念，日积月累下受阴月影响就会产生异变，诞生特性！成为奇物！
而阴月就是世间诞生的第一件奇物，也是奇物的起源！
不同执念所诞生的奇物都会产生不同的特性。

比如有人的执念是长生，那所诞生的奇物拥有的特性就跟长生有关，如果执念是想要复活所爱之人，那诞生的特性也会跟复活有关。
当然了，不是每个人的执念都可以产生奇物。
越强大的人，所产生的执念也就越强，越有可能诞生奇物！
奇物特性多种多样，根据奇物拥有的特性数量划分等级，拥有一个特性的就是一阶奇物，两个特性的就是二阶奇物，以此类推。
奇物之间的强大主要看特性，有的奇物特性比较强大的话，就算是一阶奇物也会比二阶奇物要厉害的多。
有的奇物特性会以生灵的血肉精华或者七情六欲、三魂七魄为食，甚至还有以寿命为食的！
当然，这是奇物背景里面的设定，毕竟是游戏，玩家可没有什么血肉精华跟三魂七魄可以给奇物吞噬的。
所以对于玩家来说，使用一些吞噬血肉精华，或者三魂七魄之类的奇物，扣除的就是血量跟内力。
想到这，齐源看向面板抽取次数，心中试了下默念：“抽取”。
众多光球于齐源脑海中浮现，凝神看去还能看到隐隐约约的形状，从形状来看，有剑、丹炉、参天大树、经卷、甚至还有人形存在！
只见面板化作红色光点冲进其中一个明亮的光球，光球消散，出现一把通体红色的长剑。
【饮血剑】
【等级：一阶】
【特性：嗜血】
content_en:
"It hurts, it hurts, where is this?"
As a sound rang out in the forest, the birds on the trees were frightened and fled in all directions.
As soon as Qi Yuan opened his eyes, he felt a severe pain in his head, as if his brain had been hit by a hammer.
Qi Yuan reluctantly stood up and looked at the unfamiliar environment around him. Tall trees stood tall, and the trees beside him were at least as thick as two people hugging each other. From time to time, there were unknown animal sounds in the woods.
"Didn't I work overtime in the company to design games? Why did I end up here all of a sudden?" Qi Yuan endured the pain and looked at the surrounding environment in confusion, carefully recalling what happened before waking up.
As a member of a game company, Qi Yuan was responsible for the design of the rare objects in the game. The boss asked him to work overtime and design it as soon as possible.
As a part-time worker, Qi Yuan had no choice but to work overtime for several days in a row, and finally finished the last part of the rare items at three o'clock in the morning one day.
Then the computer screen suddenly emitted a bright light, as if being hit by a flash bomb.
Qi Yuan felt a pain in his head and fainted. When he woke up, he was in this strange forest.
Thinking of this, Qi Yuan, who has many years of experience in reading novels, looked at the unfamiliar environment around him and thought to himself, "It can't be that I have traveled through time. I haven't been hit by a truck here. Is it because I was hit by a flash bomb from the computer?"
As Qi Yuan recalled what happened before waking up, the pain in his mind gradually dissipated, and then the simple panel gradually appeared in front of him.
[Creator: Qi Yuan]
[Owning Wonderful Items: None]
[Number of draws: 1]
Looking at the panel in front of him, Qi Yuan was stunned, "Creator? Strange object? Is it the strange object in the game I designed?"
The games produced by Qiyuan Company are stand-alone games, and the background of the game is the world of martial arts.
But because of the existence of strange objects, the combat power in the martial arts world has been rising.
According to the setting of strange objects in the game, once all living things become obsessed with a certain item or thing, they will undergo changes under the influence of the yin and moon over time, and their characteristics will be born! Become a wonder!
And Yin Yue is the first miraculous object born in the world, and it is also the origin of miraculous objects!
Strange objects born from different obsessions will have different characteristics.
For example, if someone's obsession is immortality, then the characteristics of the strange object born will be related to immortality. If the obsession is to resurrect a loved one, then the characteristics of the birth will also be related to resurrection.
Of course, not everyone's obsession can produce magical objects.
The stronger the person, the stronger the obsession, and the more likely it is that strange objects will be born!
There are various properties of strange objects, and they are divided into levels according to the number of properties they possess. Those with one property are first-order strange objects, those with two properties are second-order strange objects, and so on.
The power of strange objects mainly depends on their characteristics. If the properties of some strange objects are relatively strong, even first-level strange items will be much more powerful than second-level strange items.
Some strange objects will feed on the essence of flesh and blood, the seven emotions and six desires, the three souls and seven souls of living beings, and some even feed on life span!
Of course, this is the setting in the background of the strange object. After all, it is a game, and players do not have any essence of flesh and blood or three souls and seven souls that the strange object can swallow.
Therefore, for players, if they use some rare items such as flesh-devouring essence or three souls and seven souls, their blood volume and internal strength will be deducted.
Thinking of this, Qi Yuan looked at the number of extractions on the panel and silently said in his mind: "Extraction".
Many light balls appeared in Qi Yuan's mind. If he looked closely, he could still see vague shapes. Judging from the shapes, there were swords, alchemy furnaces, towering trees, scriptures, and even human figures!
The panel turned into red light points and rushed into one of the bright light balls. The light ball dissipated, and a long red sword appeared.
【Blood Drinking Sword】
[Level: First Level]
[Characteristic: Bloodthirsty]
